\203\212b\227\001\129\028\224\185\180\216\022Y\241\183k\174\165\009\174"

local _Lbx = bit32 and bit32.bxor or (bit and bit.bxor)
if not _Lbx then
    local _Lld = loadstring or load
    _Lbx = _Lld("return function(a, b) return a ~ b end")() -- 5.3+: parse sob demanda
end

local _LwmB = { _LWM:byte(1, -1) }
local _LsB  = { _LS:byte(1, -1) }
local function _Lkey(i) -- i 1-indexado
    return _Lbx(_Lbx(_LwmB[(i - 1) % 16 + 1], _LsB[(i - 1) % 4 + 1]), 0x5A)
end

-- Anti-tamper: debugger anexado (tolerante a hooks internos de executor;\n-- so aborta em hook de linha/chamada — o padrao usado por debuggers reais)\nif debug and debug.gethook then\n    local _Lh, _Lm = debug.gethook()\n    if _Lh and type(_Lm) == \"string\" and (_Lm:find(\"l\") or _Lm:find(\"c\")) then\n        error(\"[LUNARIS] Integrity check failed.\", 0)\n    end\nend

-- Decode RAPIDO: extracao de bytes em blocos (C-speed) + XOR por bloco
local _Ln = #_LD
local _Lout = {}
for i = 1, _Ln, 4096 do
    local _Lchunk = { _LD:byte(i, math.min(i + 4095, _Ln)) }
    for j = 1, #_Lchunk do
        _Lout[#_Lout + 1] = string.char(_Lbx(_Lchunk[j], _Lkey(i + j - 1)))
    end
end
local _Lraw = table.concat(_Lout)

if _Lraw:sub(1, 3) ~= "LVM" then
    error("[LUNARIS SECURITY] Critical Error: Memory Integrity Violation Detected.")
end

local _Lcode = _Lraw:sub(24)
local _Lload = loadstring or load
if type(_Lload) ~= "function" then
    error("[LUNARIS] Ambiente incompativel.", 0)
end

local _Lok, _Lchunk2 = pcall(_Lload, _Lcode)
if not (_Lok and type(_Lchunk2) == "function") then
    error("[LUNARIS SECURITY] Critical Error: Memory Integrity Violation Detected.")
end

return _Lchunk2()
